source_locator: DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0137133 abstract results materials methods and data availability
observed_fact: The 2015 primary study describes non-ulcerated non-neuropathic diabetic versus non-diabetic foot skin and deposits its microarray profiles under GSE68186
adjudication_use: Establish biological meaning and original-publication provenance of the foot-skin controls
interpretation_boundary: The paper reports cohort summaries but not a public participant identifier for each GEO sample

source_locator: PMC6358418 results transcriptome-profiling methods and supplement description
observed_fact: The later DFU study analyzed six DFU specimens with six previously published GSE68186 foot-skin controls and used both DFS and NFS controls because their expression differences were minor
adjudication_use: Establish that GSE80178 deliberately reuses the earlier foot-skin controls and define the DFU-versus-FS contrast
interpretation_boundary: The design statement does not make DFS and NFS biologically identical; they remain explicit comparator strata
